mapper.sql: id , product_id, tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_id, product_type, product_serial_number, monomer_id, area_id, craft_type
mapper.select:
select tccpl.id as id, product.id as productId, tccpw.welding_serial_number as weldSerialNumber, product.name as productName,
product.initial_serial_number as productSerialNumber,
product.serial_number as productSerialNumber,
product.specification as productSpecification, product.length as productLength, product.material as productMaterial, product.quantity as weldCount, product.drawing_number as productDwgNum, tccs.id as techCappCraftCardStorehouseId, tccs.serial_number techCappCraftCardStorehouseSerialNumber, tccpw.craft_type as craftType, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tech_capp_craft_product_task tpk WHERE tpk.product_id = product.id AND tpk.bool_delete_enum = 0 LIMIT 1 ) THEN true ELSE false END as isIssued from tech_capp_craft_card_product_welding tccpw
inner join tech_artifact as product on tccpw.serial_number = product.serial_number and product.bool_delete_enum = 0
inner join tech_assemble as product on tccpw.serial_number = product.initial_serial_number and product.bool_delete_enum = 0
left join tech_capp_craft_card_product_link as tccpl on product.id = tccpl.product_id and tccpl.welding_serial_number = tccpw.welding_serial_number and tccpl.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse as tccs on tccpl.tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_id = tccs.id
tccpw.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tccpw.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
and tccpw.product_type = #{productType}
and product.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
and tccpl.product_id is not null
and tccpl.product_id is null
and product.area_id = #{areaId}
and tccpw.craft_type = #{craftType}
and te.batch_number like concat('%',#{batchNumber},'%')
and product.specification like concat('%',#{productSpecification},'%')
and product.material like concat('%',#{productMaterial},'%')
and tccpw.welding_serial_number like concat('%',#{weldSerialNumber},'%')
and product.name like concat('%',#{productName},'%')
and product.serial_number like concat('%',#{productSerialNumber},'%')
and tccs.serial_number like concat('%',#{techCappCraftCardStorehouseSerialNumber},'%')
and product.drawing_number like concat('%',#{productDwgNum},'%')
ORDER BY tccpw.create_time IS NULL, tccpw.create_time DESC
